items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: Well I went in the Lipscomb band.

ctx.x: Can you tell me about the blues? When was the first time you ever heard anybody sing the blues or play the blues?

The blues, that was when, when Frankie Brown, when I first joined the band, and maybe before I joined the band. Now before I joined the Excelsior band, I began to pick up a little music around there. I got some of the fellas in the Excelsior band, gave me a few lessons. And I joined the band, they got up a little band around there in the Ponkinette band. He was a, he was a man too, he had about six or seven in his family and he had a regular orchestra in his family. He had one sister and about five or six…

and they just got right down to music and they'd take all the Uyghur bands jobs and everything else. There was one of them but the Excelsior band. There's others that get jobs too once in a while in between. But the Excelsior band had to go, you can see from this book. And that's just when I joined it, you see.
